name: IDX stock fundamentals
description: Source-backed fundamentals (FY2020 onward plus the latest quarter), dividends, corporate actions and end-of-day daily prices for banks, energy companies and consumer staples companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Every fundamental number carries its source document, source type, as-of date and page; prices carry their source per file. Not investment advice.

units.money: IDR billion, or USD million for issuers whose `currency` is "USD" (never converted)
units.per_share: IDR per share as printed (raw) — apply splits from corporate_actions.json using each value's share_basis
units.price: IDR per share AS TRADED in prices/*.json — divide by each split factor in the file's `splits` for rows dated before its ex_date
units.volume: shares traded in the regular market session
